worldcombat.skill.spikes.summary: Scatter sharp shards over a patch of ground so they stand up as a ring of spikes: a grounded foe that steps in is cut once and keeps getting cut while it stays. Only grounded bodies are cut - anything flying passes above. Laying spikes on the same patch again adds a layer, and every layer makes each cut heavier.
worldcombat.skill.spikes.use.0: Close off a narrow path or a doorway in advance
worldcombat.skill.spikes.use.1: Herd foes into or out of a patch of ground
worldcombat.skill.spikes.use.2: Stack layers on the same ground for heavier cuts
worldcombat.skill.spikes.description.0: The first layer cuts for about %1$s power per tread; each further layer on the same patch adds %2$s to that cut. The foe's Defence, type matchup and criticals settle at impact.
worldcombat.skill.spikes.description.1: The spike ring is about %1$s blocks wide and lasts %2$s; a grounded foe that stands inside is cut again every %3$s. Airborne bodies pass above it.
worldcombat.skill.spikes.option.on: Dense on: the ring narrows to about 0.75x, each layer's cut is about x1.2, it lasts longer and cuts sooner - smaller reach and a longer cooldown, for sealing one narrow path.
worldcombat.skill.spikes.option.off: Dense off (spread): the ring lays about 1.2x wider and each layer's cut is about x0.9 with a shorter life - more ground and a shorter cooldown, for covering a wide patch.
worldcombat.skill.spikes.timing: Lay the spikes at a point within %1$s: after %2$s of preparation it spends %4$s PP; the recovery is %3$s and the cooldown %5$s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.spikes.growth.0: At level %1$s, the per-layer cut rises to %2$s and the spike ring to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.spikes.growth.1: At level %1$s, the per-layer cut rises to %2$s and the per-layer gain to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.spikes.preference.dens: On: the ring narrows to about 0.75x, each layer's cut is about x1.2, it lasts longer and cuts sooner, with a longer cooldown - for sealing one narrow path. Off: spread form, about 1.2x wider, each layer's cut about x0.9 and a shorter life - for covering a wide patch.
worldcombat.skill.spikes.preference.ai.m: The partner only considers laying spikes while a threat is this close; smaller keeps it for nearby ground, larger lets it seed the path ahead.
Laying spikes is prioritised only when at least this many foes crowd together; set to 1 to lay on sight.
